license: Synthetic test-fixture data; not derived from real AgERA5. The substrate stays in-tree under this synthetic shape until the V2-19.5 Data Bootstrapper ships and produces real AgERA5-derived per-zone aggregates from the designated CI runner. Values here are chosen to exercise the four CompatibilityVerdict branches across the 6-crop AC-F-0 envelope; absolute magnitudes are NOT climate-realistic — in particular, BSh's P90 extreme tmax is held at 35 °C to keep the four Sahel-canonical crops (sorghum / millet / cowpea / groundnut) in MARGINAL_HETEROGENEOUS rather than INCOMPATIBLE. Real Sahel BSh peaks well above 40 °C; do NOT calibrate any threshold against this fixture.
stage_1_scope_note: Sprint F AC-F-3 — five canonical Köppen-Geiger zones with per-zone aggregates that the wizard reads to populate ZoneAggregate inputs at validation time. Schema mirrors prismpy.validators.input_base.ZoneAggregate (precip P25/P50/P75 + thermal P10 extreme tmin / P90 extreme tmax + n_cell_days). n_cells is informational only; n_cell_days is what the AC-Q2-E sample-quality threshold compares against.

fields.label: Human-readable zone name shown in the wizard banner + cockpit drawer
fields.n_cells: Count of distinct cells contributing to the zone aggregate (informational)
fields.n_cell_days: Cells × per-cell day-coverage; compared to MIN_CELL_DAYS_PER_ZONE for the sample-quality gate
fields.precip: Per-cell annual mean precip percentiles in mm/yr (P25, P50, P75)
fields.thermal: Per-cell extreme percentiles in °C (P10 of cell-minimum-of-daily-tmin; P90 of cell-maximum-of-daily-tmax)
